nodes.title: Define and enforce the stage target coefficient semantics
nodes.implementation: Choose canonical strict-lower construction with validated Gamma inverse transformation, or retain full native coefficients and include their leakage in a verified target enclosure. Explicitly bind alpha+Gamma versus rounded L semantics. Do not silently zero coefficients inside certificate only.
acceptance: Record native coefficient bits and target identifier.
Prove mathematical equality or quantified data-perturbation allowance between sequential and full-block consumers.
Any proof invoking H^8=0 checks exact structural zeros in its own target.

nodes.title: Implement Rust outward certificate reference for small targets
nodes.implementation: Add residual enclosure, verified inverse witness interface, positive outward recurrence, output/embedded projection rounding and fixed candidate scale. Use exact oracle fixtures for arithmetic edge cases.
acceptance: All24 recorded bounded fixtures enclosed on matching target.
underflow/cancellation/overflow handled with explicit fail-closed semantics.
Certification kind distinguishes stage-target bound from ODE error estimator.

nodes.title: Construct scalable structure-preserving inverse witness
nodes.implementation: Start diagonal/block-triangular/banded W. For a general approximate inverse V verify |I-VW|<=R and a suitable comparison inverse, without assuming JVP access implies entrywise absolute bounds.
acceptance: Matrix/operator identity ties witness to h,J,preconditioner and tolerances.
All inverse residual arithmetic enclosed.
Witness work/storage and rebuild/reuse cost recorded.

nodes.title: Run block structured three-level certificate and radius predictor
nodes.implementation: Predict D from authorized past step data, assemble comparison H, evaluate finite path sum with block operations, then validate radius closure and output budgets. Keep all failed predictors in ledger.
acceptance: No exact root/candidate reference leakage into D prediction.
All closure failures reject or fallback.
Independently compare enclosures with exact/small interval oracle.
Measure serial and actual worker execution including certificate work.

nodes.title: Replace q2 eighth diagnostic only after equivalent admission
nodes.implementation: Keep the seventh-batch q2 candidate exactly fixed. Substitute rigorous native-target output/embedded admission for q=0 diagnostic, then remove only that unapplied diagnostic batch.
acceptance: Candidate output/stages bit identity before/after diagnostic removal.
Wrong or unverified certificate cannot fast-accept.
W batch7 and certificate work separately accounted; fallback transaction preserved.

nodes.title: Measure matched-accuracy full-attempt speedup
nodes.implementation: Compare serial baseline versus P=1,2,4,8 at equal output grid and tolerance. Include witness construction, RHS/JVP, certificate, rejected attempts and fallback in independent-session paired timings.
acceptance: Same correctness/accuracy gate for all lanes.
No synthetic clock promoted as speed measurement.
Report p1,pf,certificate fraction,vector work,memory and total wall time.
Fail if significant work-accuracy regression or admission mismatch.
